unaccepted_candidates.reason: Commons usage associates this crop with the SNP leader, but embedded European Parliament metadata names the Irish peace campaigner. Description date is 2015 while copyright and transmission code indicate 1990. No file imported or identity approved.
University of Stirling Scottish Political Archive caption identifies the SNP leader and November 1987, but the file is All rights reserved. No image downloaded or added to the accepted manifest.
